QUOTE: Persistence: `save_permission` (`permission_persister.cpp:227`) writes a pattern into the project YAML under `permissions.allow` or `permissions.deny`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes persisting a pattern to project YAML, but it never names config.local.yaml. It also never contrasts that write with an in-memory add_permission call, so the specific mechanism the item requires is absent.
